code.trainer_iou_expression: tp / union if union else float('nan')
code.label_policy: label=-1 ignored; label=0 land; label=1 water; finite SAR required
code.code_checks: PASS: syntactic checks only; manual review still required

protocol.scope: development protocol freeze; NOT training or independent testing
protocol.task: binary surface-water segmentation from two-channel Sentinel-1 SAR
protocol.source_dataset: Sen1Floods11 hand-labeled SAR/label pairs, local data root
protocol.valid_pixel_policy: label!=-1 AND both SAR bands finite; do not discard land=0 based on label nodata metadata
protocol.normalization_note: Fixed presets; confirm TIFF provenance and units manually; do not fit ranges on TEST

reserved.thailand: Diagnostic pilot only until aligned, independently validated GT exists
reserved.test_and_bolivia_csvs: empty compatibility stubs in all V2 dev roots

training.train_augmentations: random crop, horizontal/vertical flip and 90-degree rotations
training.development_fold_checkpoint_selection: best VALID micro water IoU; patience on VALID IoU
training.candidate_model_selection: mean of event-level VALID water IoU across 3 development folds; decide before examining new TEST
training.maximum_samples: full fold train/valid; do not use --max-train or --max-val for full runs

evaluation.per_image_iou: IoU NaN if GT-water and predicted-water union is empty; report count of NaN images
evaluation.reporting: event-level scores; pixel values are spatially correlated; no image-as-event claims
evaluation.test_policy: no TEST threshold fitting, calibration, hyperparameter selection or method selection

code_check.trainer_iou_expression: tp / union if union else float('nan')
code_check.label_policy: label=-1 ignored; label=0 land; label=1 water; finite SAR required
code_check.code_checks: PASS: syntactic checks only; manual review still required

protocol.method_comparison_policy: V1 and V2 must be retrained on identical V2 development folds/seeds before comparison
